description: Show a deeper 5-layer network [2, 4, 8, 4, 2] as a static architecture diagram — good for illustrating encoder-decoder symmetry.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_ml.neural_network import NeuralNetwork, FeedForwardLayer

class FFNDeep(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        nn = NeuralNetwork([
            FeedForwardLayer(2),
            FeedForwardLayer(4),
            FeedForwardLayer(8),
            FeedForwardLayer(4),
            FeedForwardLayer(2),
        ], layer_spacing=0.2)
        nn.scale(0.9)
        nn.move_to(ORIGIN)
        title = Text("Autoencoder", font_size=28).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(nn, title)
        self.wait(0.5)
